name: notification
title: Notification
description: A real notification-shaped product moment: alert, reminder, task done, system update, approval, message, or 'your X is ready' event. Avoid for generic URL launches, broad brand announcements, or product explanations.

vanillasky.useWhen: A real notification-shaped product moment: alert, reminder, task done, system update, approval, message, or 'your X is ready' event. Avoid for generic URL launches, broad brand announcements, or product explanations.

appName.label: App name
appName.description: App name shown in the notification header (e.g. Reminder, Lume, Linear, GitHub).

appIcon.label: App icon
appIcon.description: Single emoji used as the app icon. Override the default 🔔 to retheme: 📅 reminder, ✅ task done, 💌 message, 🎉 celebration, ⚡ system event.

message.label: Message
message.default: Believe in your dreams, they will lead you.
message.description: The notification body — 1-2 lines reads best.

textColor.label: Text color
textColor.description: Override text color (leave empty for auto).

mediaUrl.label: Background media
mediaUrl.description: Optional photo or video URL behind this scene. When set, replaces the brand gradient.

mediaKeyword.label: Background search keyword
mediaKeyword.description: 2-4 word English term for Pexels stock-footage search (auto-fills mediaUrl).

mediaType.label: Background media type
mediaType.description: auto detects photo/video from URL. 'gradient' is a deliberate mode — atmospheric brand-color scene with no stock footage.

mediaPoster.label: Background poster image
mediaPoster.description: Still image URL shown while a video backdrop is decoding its first frame. Auto-filled from Pexels' thumbnail when fillPexelsUrls sets a video mediaUrl. Hides the gradient flash that would otherwise appear in the ~50–400ms gap between a <video> mounting and decoding its first frame.

defaultVariables.message: Believe in your dreams, they will lead you.
